question: 平均每个集群组有多少个集群

ground_truth.sql: SELECT AVG(cluster_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(c.id) as cluster_count FROM db_cluster_group g LEFT JOIN db_cluster c ON g.cluster_group_id = c.cluster_group_id GROUP BY g.cluster_group_id) subquery

question: 实例数量最多的集群是哪个

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.cluster_name, COUNT(i.id) as cnt FROM db_cluster c LEFT JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id GROUP BY c.cluster_id, c.cluster_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

question: 按数据库类型统计集群数量

ground_truth.sql: SELECT cluster_db_type, COUNT(*) FROM db_cluster GROUP BY cluster_db_type

question: 查询实例数超过5的集群

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.cluster_name, COUNT(i.id) as ins_cnt FROM db_cluster c LEFT JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id GROUP BY c.cluster_id, c.cluster_name HAVING COUNT(i.id) > 5

question: 每种数据库类型的平均实例数

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.cluster_db_type, AVG(ins_count) FROM (SELECT c.cluster_id, c.cluster_db_type, COUNT(i.id) as ins_count FROM db_cluster c LEFT JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id GROUP BY c.cluster_id, c.cluster_db_type) subquery GROUP BY cluster_db_type

question: 显示拥有集群数量排名前3的集群组

ground_truth.sql: SELECT g.cluster_group_name, COUNT(c.id) as cluster_cnt FROM db_cluster_group g LEFT JOIN db_cluster c ON g.cluster_group_id = c.cluster_group_id GROUP BY g.cluster_group_id, g.cluster_group_name ORDER BY cluster_cnt DESC LIMIT 3

question: 统计每种实例角色的数量

ground_truth.sql: SELECT ins_role, COUNT(*) FROM db_cluster_instance GROUP BY ins_role ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: 查询实例数量超过平均值的集群

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.cluster_name, COUNT(i.id) as instance_count FROM db_cluster c LEFT JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id GROUP BY c.cluster_id, c.cluster_name HAVING COUNT(i.id) > (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(i2.id) as cnt FROM db_cluster c2 LEFT JOIN db_cluster_instance i2 ON c2.cluster_id = i2.cluster_id GROUP BY c2.cluster_id) subquery)

question: 按HA类型统计集群数量，并按数量降序排列

ground_truth.sql: SELECT cluster_ha_type, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM db_cluster GROUP BY cluster_ha_type ORDER BY cnt DESC

question: 找出实例数最多的前5个集群

ground_truth.sql: SELECT c.cluster_name, COUNT(i.id) as ins_cnt FROM db_cluster c LEFT JOIN db_cluster_instance i ON c.cluster_id = i.cluster_id GROUP BY c.cluster_id, c.cluster_name ORDER BY ins_cnt DESC LIMIT 5
